paper_title: Continual Dialogue State Tracking via Reason-of-Select Distillation
caption: : Avg. JGA score at each turn
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average JGA score at each turn for two models, LLaMA-7B and T5-small. The horizontal axis represents the turn ID, labeled from 0 to 26 in increments of 2, while the vertical axis represents the average JGA score, ranging from 0.2 to 1 in increments of 0.1. The chart features grouped bars, with each group consisting of two bars, one for LLaMA-7B (orange) and one for T5-small (yellow), representing the average JGA score for each turn ID. At turn ID 0, both models have a score of approximately 0.95, while at turn ID 2, the scores are around 0.85 for LLaMA-7B and 0.72 for T5-small. The scores generally decrease as the turn ID increases, with LLaMA-7B consistently scoring higher than T5-small, except at turn ID 0 where they are nearly equal. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
